hero.title: Procurement
hero.lead: Transparent procedures for selecting suppliers of goods, works, and services

goal.title: Purpose and principles
goal.body: The main goal of procurement is the efficient and timely satisfaction of the Company’s needs for products (goods, works, and services).
items: Equal access for participants and documented procedure stages.
Economic justification of supplier and contractor selection.

legal.title: Legal framework
legal.body: Procurement is carried out in accordance with Federal Law No. 223-FZ of 18 July 2011, related regulations, and the company’s internal policies.

platforms.title: Official information sources
platforms.lead: Procurement notices are published on the following platforms

eis.title: Unified procurement information system
eis.body: The official public procurement portal under Russian law.

rts.title: RTS-tender platform
rts.body: Electronic trading platform used for procurement procedures.
